The patient had a recent event of syncope

The service is medically necessary to evaluate the patient's symptoms of palpitations, dizziness, and syncope
The service is medically necessary in the context of the diagnoses of I47.1, R42, and R55
The Holter monitor is a 48-hour Holter monitoring study
